title: Countries of South America and their capitals
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: Twelve countries, from the Caribbean coast to Cape Horn. It is the shortest of the continent lists, so it is a good place to start.

How to hold it: Chunk by region. A whole continent is too much to hold at once, so the list is learned a region at a time, in groups of about five. Use picture plus words: say each pair out loud while you point to the country on a map (the Geography Ladder has maps). The map works like a memory palace, so walk it in the same direction each time. Where a capital has a story or a meaning, picture it; the hooks give some to start with. Then close the book and recall, and come back on day 1, 3, 7 and 21.
